description: This file contains CSS styles for theming and layout of the App component in a Tic Tac Toe web application. It defines CSS variables for light and dark themes, styles for the App header, logo, and a theme toggle button, as well as responsive design adjustments.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container for the application with styles for centering and theming.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header section of the application featuring background color and flexibility for content arrangement.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button element for toggling between light and dark themes with various hover effects.
